latest.description: It walks through the business case, the Zero Trust uplift, the surrounding modernization architecture, and the final AI integration using serverless and Bedrock, all delivered with no rewrites, no downtime, and no unexpected cost.

latest.title: Hooks in KIRO: How to Automate Repetitive Tasks with Smart Triggers
latest.description: How many times a day do you ask the agent to run linting, generate tests, or update documentation? If the answer is “many,” then Kiro’s agent hooks are for you. Instead of repeating these requests manually, you define a rule once and Kiro handles the rest automatically and consistently. In this post, we’ll explore what hooks are, how they work, the types of available triggers, and how to create your own from scratch.

latest.title: Prompt AI Coding Assistants to Build Production-Ready Agents: 8 Essential Patterns
latest.description: When you ask an AI assistant like Kiro, Claude Code, or ChatGPT to "build me an agent," you get working code. But you don't see the architecture decisions happening behind the scenes. The agent responds to queries, but it might waste tokens in reasoning loops, hallucinate answers from incomplete data, or freeze on slow APIs. These failures are silent until production.

latest.title: Computação em nuvem pode ser divertida? Sim, e um jogo de labirinto me ajudou a provar isso.
latest.description: Aprender computação em nuvem pode ser divertido? Sim. Criei um jogo de labirinto no Scratch com os logos da Estácio e da AWS, hospedei na nuvem e usei para ensinar sobre escalabilidade, IA e arquitetura de computadores. Os alunos interagiram, torceram e entenderam na prática como a tecnologia pode ser acessível.

latest.title: AI Fundamentals for the AWS AI Practitioner
latest.description: In this article, I’ll share the knowledge I consider essential for working with AI on AWS and preparing for the AI Practitioner certification. Before exploring services and use cases, I believe building a strong theoretical foundation is essential, since understanding the concepts first makes the practical side much easier. We’ll start with broad AI concepts and gradually move toward practical model adaptation strategies through a sequence of questions that naturally arise as the topic evolves.

latest.title: AI-Assisted MAP Business Case: From Legacy .NET to Full Modernization Plan Before Lunch
latest.description: What happens when you point an AI agent at a real AWS MAP business case for a legacy .NET modernization? Nine structured deliverables, two architecture diagrams, a full TCO model, and a funded migration strategy — all from a single workshop session instead of the usual 2–3 weeks. This isn't chatbot territory: it's iterative, context-aware orchestration where corrections propagate across every dependent document. A practical look at agentic AI for AWS Partners building MAP cases.
